card.name: Words leading into dose statements
card.fires_on: Small linking or adjective words such as "recommended", "in", "used" and "dose" that come right before a dose amount or dosing range in the dosage section of a drug label.

modes.label: Recommended before dose
modes.description: The word "recommended" (or "Recommended") introducing a recommended needle size, dose, or duration.
modes.example: The<< recommended>> needle size for administration of INVEGA

modes.label: In before doses
modes.description: The word "in" or "used" after an effectiveness or use statement, just before a list of doses or patients.
modes.example: Safety and efficacy has been demonstrated<< in>> doses up to 100 mg

card.writes: It seems to lower the odds of size words like smaller or larger and nudges toward other continuations.
card.plain: It fires on the words that set up a dose or range, such as "recommended" or "in", just before the numbers.
